description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms” visually compares the accuracy of three text annotation methods — VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT — for sentiment analysis, as referenced in the paper “Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis.” The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled from 0.4 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, with dashed horizontal gridlines aiding visual comparison. The horizontal x-axis lists the three algorithms: VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT. VADER is represented by a solid gray bar reaching approximately 0.70 accuracy; TextBlob is shown with a diagonally striped gray bar at roughly 0.65 accuracy; and ChatGPT is depicted with a solid green bar that reaches approximately 0.95 accuracy — the highest among the three. A legend in the upper right corner identifies the fill patterns and colors corresponding to each algorithm. The chart clearly emphasizes ChatGPT’s superior performance in this evaluation, with its bar significantly taller than the others, suggesting its effectiveness as a text annotation tool for sentiment analysis tasks.
